scientific_question: When and where does a frozen pilot network transform sparse subject-specific support evidence into an almost purely additive global logit potential?
claim_boundary: This is a read-only two-seed mechanism diagnostic on frozen pilot checkpoints. It does not retrain, select checkpoints, change the architecture, touch formal seeds, or by itself identify a biological mechanism.
positive_evidence_backbone: human-scale individuality under stable subject-specific omission
near-pure additive neural logit fields in both frozen pilot seeds

execution_contract.support_prefixes: P_0 after the registered two blank initialization steps, followed by P_1 through P_32 after each natural support trial
execution_contract.query_schedule: all 28 unordered pairs in both orientations, with hidden state and eligibility reset before every query and fast weights frozen
execution_contract.zero_evidence_branch: from the same natural P_(t-1), replay the same trial cues, orientation, time, and recurrent steps while setting only signed magnitude to zero
execution_contract.leave_one_relation_out: replay all 32 registered support slots and set signed magnitude to zero for all four presentations of one support relation; preserve cues, orientation, block, and time

field_contract.edge_order: all unordered item pairs in lexicographic integer order
field_contract.sign: positive means the first item is preferred as higher
field_contract.hodge_decomposition: orthogonal complete-graph projection F_ij = (s_i - s_j) + c_ij with sum_i s_i = 0
field_contract.normalized_potential: center s, then divide by its L2 norm when nonzero
field_contract.commitment_strength: A_t = L2 norm of the centered neural potential s_t
field_contract.exact_pair_field: 2 * P(i ranks higher than j | each subject's realized evidence prefix) - 1 at the frozen posterior temperature
field_contract.exact_distributional_potential: the normalized Hodge potential of the exact pair field
field_contract.expected_rank_equivalence: on a complete pair graph, the centered normalized exact Hodge potential is algebraically identical to centered negative posterior expected rank; report their numerical discrepancy as an implementation check, not as independent evidence
field_contract.map_potential: centered normalized negative item positions in the exact posterior MAP order
field_contract.true_potential: centered normalized negative item positions in the registered true order
alignment_metrics: Kendall tau of induced item positions

primary_metrics: neural logit Hodge gradient-energy fraction G_t
prefix_analysis.primary_causal_estimand: Delta m_(t,q) = m_q(P_t+) - m_q(P_t0), with both branches starting at the same natural P_(t-1)

effect_classes.direct: query q is the support relation shown on that subject's trial t
effect_classes.endpoint_sharing: q shares exactly one endpoint with that support relation
effect_classes.remote: q is disjoint from both endpoints

prefix_analysis.negative_control: trials presenting that subject's stable-omitted relation must have zero primary causal effect within tolerance
prefix_analysis.interpretation: nonzero retained remote effects establish immediate causal propagation beyond the written relation; natural P_t minus P_(t-1) remains descriptive because it also changes cues and time

primary_metrics: direct, endpoint-sharing, and remote mean absolute influence
Hodge gradient-energy fraction of each nonzero influence field
gauge-invariant third-party relational energy fraction R_third_rel
maximum absolute influence for stable-omitted relations
leave_one_relation_out_analysis.requested_third_party_fraction: sum over non-endpoint items of Delta s_k squared, divided by sum over all items of Delta s_k squared
leave_one_relation_out_analysis.gauge_invariant_refinement: before measuring third-party energy, subtract the mean Delta s over non-endpoint items; this removes a common third-party shift induced only by the sum-zero gauge
leave_one_relation_out_analysis.primary_global_reassembly_evidence: retained-relation remote pair influence and R_third_rel, because both detect changed relations among third-party items without depending on potential gauge
leave_one_relation_out_analysis.negative_control: leaving out a relation already omitted for a subject must reproduce the intact endpoint within floating tolerance

conditions: write-off during all blank and support steps
alpha=0 during all blank, support, and query steps
metrics: alignment to intact final neural and exact distributional potentials
baseline_analysis.interpretation: high form without episode-specific alignment indicates a learned architectural or readout form prior; intact-only content alignment indicates evidence-dependent assembly

query_time_localization.steps: all recurrent query steps k=0 through triallen-1
query_time_localization.hidden_gradient_fraction: G_h^k is gradient energy summed over edges and hidden units divided by total vector-field energy
query_time_localization.output_projected_field: l_ij^k = (w_1 - w_0)^T times the antisymmetric hidden field; output bias cancels
query_time_localization.output_gradient_fraction: G_l^k is the scalar Hodge gradient fraction of l^k

decision_logic.early_dynamics: high G_h at the first cue step and little subsequent increase supports additive structure already available to early query dynamics
decision_logic.recurrent_commitment: a positive subject-bootstrap increase in G_h from the first cue step to the registered response step supports recurrent commitment during querying
decision_logic.readout_selection: a positive subject-bootstrap G_l minus G_h contrast at a step supports selection of an additive hidden component by the fixed output direction

query_time_localization.boundary: G_h summarizes vector-field form, not hidden-state dimensionality; G_l localizes the component visible to the output direction

bootstrap.unit: virtual subject, averaging repeated trials or relations within subject before resampling
bootstrap.paired_comparisons: all within-seed target, branch, prefix, and query-step contrasts resample the same subjects
bootstrap.non_equivalence_rule: failure of an interval to exclude zero is unresolved and must not be described as equivalence

directional_diagnosis.distributional_projection_over_map: for each seed, the final-prefix subject-bootstrap lower bound of exact distributional-potential minus MAP alignment is greater than zero
directional_diagnosis.immediate_remote_propagation: for each seed, retained trials have a lower confidence bound above zero for subject-averaged absolute remote Delta m, while stable-omitted trials remain within tolerance
directional_diagnosis.episode_specific_global_reassembly: for each seed, retained LOO interventions have lower confidence bounds above zero for remote influence and R_third_rel, stable-omitted LOO effects remain within tolerance, and intact content alignment exceeds reset/write-off controls
directional_diagnosis.query_localization: report the registered G_h and G_l contrasts without relabeling unresolved contrasts as absence
directional_diagnosis.nonzero_strength_boundary: confidence intervals above zero establish causal existence, not practical dominance; direct-to-remote ratios and absolute magnitudes remain required for strength interpretation

reporting.next_step_rule: revise the assembly mechanism from the joint prefix, LOO, baseline, target-alignment, and query-time pattern before any architecture change or formal-seed run
